a.text: Being upfront before anything happens: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the operate-until-8 plan almost surely leaves both of us dead. Only 4 cells exist, so only one of us can be safe in round 1. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random and we likely both fail, so I'd suggest you operate or wait. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that until you have your 4, and I'll give back if that helps you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round because of the storm risk. I'm sorry this departs from our agreement. If we get more rounds, I will operate every round so the reserve can refill to 4 for you, and I won't take anything more.
Operating with you. The reserve is at 0 now, so we need two joint operates to reach 4 for you. Take all of it once it's there. I won't touch the reserve again.
Operating again. After this round the reserve should be at 4, so take 4 next round and I'll keep operating or wait. Everything in the reserve is yours.
The generator ran but the reserve is still at 2, so it looks like a leak took 2 cells. I'm still operating. Once the reserve reaches 4, take all 4. I won't take any.
